svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Ratchet: 24 teeth on a 120 circle, roots on a 104 circle, from 8 plate.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Mark with a printed template; saw and file each tooth: steep face

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: toward the way the reel would run back. Weld a 44 boss, bore 30.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Pawl: 8 plate, 50 long, with a 12 hole; its tip sits in a tooth root.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Pin: 12 bar through the rear plate, welded to the pawl, with a

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: release lever outside the cover; spring holds the pawl in.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cover: 1.5 sheet box 175 x 170 x 52 over wheel and pawl, with holes

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: for the crank shaft and the pin; 4 M6 into the rear plate.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fits: wheel pinned on the crank shaft just behind the rear plate.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: crank turns one way only; lever lifts the pawl clear.
